title: Bras d'Or Lakes Campground

services.name: Camper Cabins
services.desc: At Bras d’Or Lakes Campground we also have two styles of camper cabins available: ‘Deluxe‘ & ‘Basic‘. Enjoy the camping lifestyle (fire pit, barbeque, cracker barrel discussions with other campers) without the initial expense of an RV! Our camping cabins are built to save you bringing your camper and give you the camping experience. You will need to bring Sleeping bags/bed linen, towels, dishes & utensils and anything else you would normally bring. Note: Two day minimum on holiday weekends Enjoy the beautifiul Cape Breton night sky, watch the bald eagles hunt for dinner, or the sunrise over the Bras d’Or from your fully screened front porch.
